places.name: Seaboy
places.why: Tiny chef-run seafood room in a converted Cornelius house from Jonny Cox (ex-Fin & Fino, Chapter 6); seasonal coastal plates built on Carolina produce, with personal, small-room service. Reserve ahead.
places.open_check: open (Unpretentious Palate named it 2026 Restaurant of the Year on 2026-11-09; official site live with online reservations)

places.name: PostScript
places.cuisine: French, Italian and American comfort food
places.why: Husband-and-wife neighborhood spot in the old Letty's space doing seasonal European-leaning comfort dishes like chicken scarpariello and mushroom stroganoff cavatelli; warm, low-key room for a relaxed date.
places.open_check: open (Unpretentious Palate 2026 New Restaurant of the Year, 2026-11-09; official site says it is open, dinner Tue-Sat)

places.name: Customshop
places.why: Kept its Michelin recommendation in the 2026 American South guide.
places.open_check: open (kitchen staff honored in Unpretentious Palate's 2026-11-09 awards as currently cooking there)

places.name: Albertine
places.address: 525 S Tryon St Ste 125, Charlotte, NC 28202
places.why: The Kindred team's uptown dining room pairing Mediterranean cooking with Southern touches; newly Michelin-recommended in 2026.
places.open_check: open (GM honored for current service in Unpretentious Palate's 2026-11-09 awards)

places.name: L'Ostrica
places.area: Park Rd / Madison Park, near Montford
places.address: 4701 Park Rd Ste D, Charlotte, NC 28209
places.why: Chef-driven tasting-menu spot with wine pairings and caviar service; picked up a new Michelin recommendation in October 2026.
places.open_check: open (pastry chef honored in Unpretentious Palate's 2026-11-09 awards)

places.name: Omakase Experience by Prime Fish
places.why: Six-seat reservation-only sushi counter from chef Robin Anthony with fish flown in from Tokyo's Toyosu market and thoughtful wine and sake pairings; a splurge separate from the walk-in Prime Fish in Ballantyne.
places.open_check: open (Unpretentious Palate 2026-11-09 named its chef Chef of the Year and its sommelier Sommelier of the Year for current service; listed in the 2026 Michelin Guide)

places.name: Menya Daruma
places.why: Handmade noodles at an open counter that locals rate the most authentic ramen/soba in town, with a hidden omakase room inside; the tonkotsu ramen is a cold-weather standout.
places.open_check: open (recommended as a current soup pick by Unpretentious Palate 2026-11-12)
